# Branches the archiver never touches. One per line: an exact name, or "re:"
# plus a regex searched in the name (anchor with ^ and $ for a whole name).
# Protected branches and open-PR head/base branches are exempt without listing.
# A line added after a branch was archived spares the archive; restoring it is
#     git push origin archive/<date>/<name>:<name>
# Say what breaks if the branch moves.

# Default branch, and the name it goes by in older clones and forks.
main
master

# The published documentation site. Deleting it takes the docs offline.
gh-pages

# Long-lived integration branch; several teams cut from it.
stable

# Release branches. 16 of these were already past 30 days on 2026-09-15, and
# being untouched for a year is what a shipped release looks like.
re:^release/.*$
re:^v[0-9].*$
